Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE comprehensive, high-resolution concept-art approval board for a Godot Android game world-asset library. This is a new original approval sheet, not a sprite atlas, not a game screenshot and not UI design. Make a single tall portrait image, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, highest useful available resolution, beautiful readable detailed catalog. Crisp labels and small but complete objects. No title/logo baked into any scene asset.

REFERENCE ROLES: The four supplied images are approved style vocabulary: 1 restaurant scene, 2 restaurant catalog, 3 underwater scene, 4 underwater catalog. Follow their colorful chunky faceted LOW-POLY geometry, matte color, broad flat faces, restrained bevels, sparse details, tiny expressive faces, warm restaurant vs turquoise/cobalt ocean. The new user-approved low-poly README supersedes any older doodle art. Do not copy the references' UI, branding, T/cross belts, extra foods, mines/spike traps or invented mechanics. This board is made from newly illustrated objects.

COMPOSITION: An elegant production art-director's contact sheet on warm very pale ivory, thin quiet dividers, generous gutters. A compact header "WORLD ASSET CATALOG" and subtitle "ISSUE 33 · CONCEPT APPROVAL · LOW-POLY". Five content rows based on FOUR equal columns. Some panels span two columns as described. Number every panel 01 through 17 with short legible headings. Every object complete and cleanly separated, except intentionally touching modular seams and occupied-seat/motion compositions. Avoid dense prose; headings and item labels only. Navy type with warm amber section accents in restaurant rows, turquoise accents underwater. No ornate frames, no gradients across the entire board, no huge empty header, no game HUD or paper menus.

STYLE/PROJECTION CRITICAL: Floors are true SCREEN-ALIGNED SQUARES with equal x/y pitch, never diamonds, never receding trapezoids. Connecting environment objects use square top/front oblique: screenX=x, screenY=depth-height; tops and aligned fronts are true shape, height rises straight upward over the square footprint. No perspective vanishing points or isometric rotated floor diamonds. Front and top visible, end-on side may collapse. Characters are undistorted low-poly chibi people, ordinary orthographic art at about 35 degree elevation, with standing feet placed at center of shown ground tile and sitting hips attached to stool seat. Not stretched anatomy. Same coherent character scale across whole sheet, large angular hair/hat masses, mitten-like readable but intentional hands, solid shoes, bright expressive eyes/mouths. Environments use gentle AO and soft grounding shadows, consistent upper-left light. No heavy ink outlines, pencil grain, realistic textures, glossy clay, voxel pixelation or photographic surfaces.

ROW FOUR:

Show short straight and L-shaped runs plus a small overhead canyon composition with a half-width barrier longer than the view and an uninterrupted ship-width passage. Integer square footprints. Actual modularity, not stretch one drawing. NO mine, spike trap, door or new hazard mechanics from old sample.
12 LAYERED SCENERY column3: restrained faceted foreground rocks/starfish/coral, midground pink/purple branching coral and green kelp/pale ruin fragments, quieter background fish silhouettes and distant wreck/rock silhouettes, little bubbles and shaft of light. Three labeled layer rows "Foreground", "Midground", "Background". Dressing visually distinct from blocking modules.
13 CREATURES column4: two families ONLY: "Eel" elongated expressive blue/teal low-poly eel with yellow fins and "Generic example" compact faceted teal fish, not a promised new species roster. Show coherent same creature across normal/swim, restless, hooked/pursuit, caught and escape tiny poses. A short three-pose eel weaving/dash/pause gesture strip. Frightened/angry eyes remain expressive and kid-friendly. No gore, no shock-shape enlargement.

ROW FIVE:
14 SALVAGE & ROUTE column1: three salvage metal fragment shapes, collection sparkle/attraction wisps, lateral current arrow ribbons, travel boost glow and short trail, paired portal rim/entry glow, tiny safe bonus-passage scenery with orderly collectible trail. No coins underwater, no UI amounts, no treasure reward panel.
15 HARPOON & CABLE column2: separate harpoon projectile; attachment sockets demonstrated between upward sub and eel; cable segments normal, taut, fraying, broken; faint narrow vertical following-region strip behind hooked eel/sub with no top/bottom boundaries. Small launch/flight/hook/break gestures. This is a scene effect, not HUD or steering mechanics.
16 ATTACK WARNINGS column3: separate reef fragments, swirl, lateral attack-current ribbons; eel warning strip AMBER diagonal hatch plus lightning mark, actual blue-white electrical discharge; windup/active/recovery miniature sequence with visible safe position outside warning. No full-screen warning tint, no health bars, no timing labels.
17 ANCHOR & MOTION STUDY column4: clearly diagrammatic three true square floor tiles with a standing chef's feet centered on ground cross, sitting guest's hips precisely on stool support, and taller terrain rising above footprint. Small orthographic character turn poses N E S W. Brief labels "Ground root", "Seat socket", "12 fps". Tiny cooking/held-dish/load gesture examples. Natural undistorted figures; no per-pose fitting.

BOTTOM FOOTNOTE only: "Concepts for approval · Production sprites and motion reviewed later in Godot". Do not add feature descriptions, progression numbers or gameplay controls. Visual completeness, warm/cool coherent art direction, readable silhouettes, consistent scale and square projected cells are the priority. All assets are original newly composed concepts, not crops from references.
